title: Explore Oshkosh's Morgan House during paranormal investigations this month
excerpt: Visitors can explore Oshkosh’s Morgan House after dark during guided paranormal investigations Oct. 23-24.
content:
Oct. 8, 2026, 4:13 a.m. CT

  • The Winnebago County Historical Society is hosting a paranormal investigation event at the Morgan House.
  • Attendees will learn investigative techniques and use specialized equipment with Windigo Paranormal Investigators.
  • The event is presented as a historical investigation experience, not a haunted house attraction.
  • General investigation sessions are available on Oct. 23 and 24, though a VIP experience has sold out.

OSHKOSH – Visitors will have a chance to explore the Morgan House after dark during a paranormal investigation event hosted by the Winnebago County Historical Society later this month.

The historical society is partnering with Windigo Paranormal Investigators for the experience, according to a community announcement. Participants will hear stories tied to reported paranormal activity at the historic home, learn investigative techniques and take part in guided investigations using specialized equipment.

Organizers said the event is designed as an investigation experience rather than a haunted house attraction. Attendees will explore the home's history while working alongside members of the Windigo Paranormal team.

General investigation sessions are scheduled for 6 p.m. Oct. 23 and 6 p.m. and 9 p.m. Oct. 24.

General investigations

Participants in the general investigation sessions will be divided into groups and rotate through five stations in different areas of the Morgan House.

According to the announcement, the structured format is intended to introduce attendees to paranormal investigation methods and provide hands-on experience with equipment used during investigations.

Members of Windigo Paranormal Investigators will demonstrate how the equipment works and guide participants through a variety of investigative approaches.

VIP experience sold out

A VIP investigation scheduled from 9 p.m. to midnight Oct. 23 has sold out.

The smaller-group experience offers additional time inside the Morgan House and more direct interaction with investigators, according to the announcement.

Tickets remain available for the general investigation sessions on both event dates.

More information and tickets are available through eventbrite.com.
